Name: Willy Buys Back Your Rods
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21578/21578-1749853542-1369958417.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Does exactly what it says on the tin!
[*]You are now able to sell your unwanted Fishing Rods to Willy.
[*][b]New in v.1.1[/b]: Training Rod, Fiberglass Rod, and Iridium Rod base prices changed to match the purchase price from Willy rather than the default (unused) tool price to prevent an unexpected money exploit.
[/list]
This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Mini-Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21578/21578-1749853548-1094475265.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21578/21578-1749853554-1904438868.png[/img][/center]
[/u][list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Willy Buys Back Your Rods[/b] to your mods folder.
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21578/21578-1749853572-1475372576.png[/img][/center]
[/u]As of v1.2.0, explicitly compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33422]Willy and Clint buy more items[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bananasalmon]bananasalmon[/url]﻿.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21578/21578-1749853578-1529308391.png[/img][/center]
Created as a request for [b]fireredlily[/b] on [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1210]GitHub[/url]. Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/159765213]Neonligt[/url] for pointing out the sell price disparity, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bananasalmon]bananasalmon[/url]﻿ for pointing out a compatibility issue in my json.
